path_a: Read the business workflow and architecture before searching.
Draft an initial threat model and at least three hypotheses.
Discover activity from the incident window. Do not start from a run identifier.
Separate signal, benign activity, control success, control gap, irrelevant evidence, missing evidence, and ambiguous evidence.
Maintain an evidence ledger and a timeline.
Bound data impact and name one NOT PROVEN question.
Write containment, remediation, a retest design, a detection candidate, and a hunt.
Revise the threat model and write SOC, engineering, and executive notes.
Open Path B only after that draft.
path_b: Reference investigation in the Path B tab. It is a review key, not policy, and not a fresh execution.
